Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Interface CompositedWindowHost

All Known Implementing Classes:
X11CompositedWindowHost
public interface CompositedWindowHost
The seam the conventional 2D desktop uses to obtain a Swing surface for a composited (redirected) native X11 window, so that window can be hosted inside a Desktop2DWindow instead of escaping as a separate top-level window owned by the host window manager.

Deliberately free of any Java 3D reference — it speaks only in terms of a JComponent and a lifecycle — so the 2D shell package (org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d) can depend on it without dragging in the scene graph. The production implementation is X11CompositedWindowHost, which wires a WindowPixelSource (CompositeWindowImageLoader) to a SwingCompositedWindowSink through a CompositedWindowPipeline. Tests supply a fake so the desktop controller can be exercised headlessly.

    • open

      CompositedWindowHost.HostedWindow open(int windowId, String title, int width, int height)
      Begins hosting a composited window: reads its redirected pixels and keeps them painted into the returned component.
      Parameters:
      windowId - the X window id of the redirected client
      title - a human-readable title (for the host window's chrome)
      width - the window's current width in pixels
      height - the window's current height in pixels
      Returns:
      a live handle to the hosted surface; never null
